s.e: Strange things do happen in the movies. F’rinstance: A writer-chap we know quite well offered an idea for a scene to a big production company. And, strange as…
Let me give you some f'rinstances.
“… Say Captain Miles Sheehan tenders his compliments tuh Miss Angelina Brady an' desires tuh offer her his heart an' han' in th' holy bonds of matrimony…
The minute we’d tetch off a blast ’n’ the fuse’d begin to sizzle, he’d give a look as much as to say: ‘Well, I’ll have to git you to excuse me,’ an’ it was…
Can we talk about how adorable Mimi is in this? Who could get mad at that? But f'real I do not recommend this look for anyone over age eight, especially with…
